guarantee: The notes listing costs one nofollow stat per entry plus a second followed stat for symlink entries, with path resolution paid only for the notes root and for symlinks, and it still means: nothing listed from outside the notes root even when a directory is swapped for a symlink mid-open, no whole-answer failure from a looping or file-traversing symlink, and no state kept between requests. Dated L55 truth preserved: the whole-tree list wire (same response bytes, depth-4 truncation, readdir-order ties, propagate-other-errors) belonged to the removed endpoint and is retired with it; the per-folder properties above are the current joint guarantee under the accepted packet.
title: Bounded notes listing with unchanged meaning
